description: L5 β-decay Q-value derivations across the recursive atom-knot atlas. For every (Z, A) with a daughter (Z+1, A) in AME 2020, computes Q_β⁻(A, Z) = M_atom(A, Z) − M_atom(A, Z+1). Both framework prediction (via composite mass M_pred = N·m_n + Z·m_p − B from canonical-isotope-witness shards) and AME reference (via M_AME = atomic_mass_u · 931.494 MeV/u) are emitted; residual in keV / ppm. The AME Q_β value from beta_decay_energy_keV is also included for triangulation.
